landmarks.name: Donnelly Park / building, deck and courts

geographicAnchor.method: source footprint bounds centre, a reference point rather than an entrance or surveyed building centre

landmarks.heightPolicy: native kit dimensions only; no surveyed height or interiors
landmarks.placementPolicy: Keep source geometry and global identity; source footprint wins over the illustrative prefab. Host owns sector pieces; do not cap seams.
limitations: No surveyed building interiors or heights.
Court/stage use is city-confirmed; five mapped court footprints are preserved as mapped, not asserted to be the current complete count.
Stage/deck shape and court paint remain explicit authoring studies, not invented native presets.
